name: Potion of Healing
description: You regain 2d4+2 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Potion of Animal Friendship
description: Grants the effect of Animal Friendship for 1 hour.

name: Potion of Clairvoyance
description: Grants the effect of Clairvoyance without concentration.

name: Potion of Climbing
description: Gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed for 1 hour.

name: Potion of Diminution
description: You shrink to a smaller size for a limited time.

name: Potion of Flying
description: Gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed for 1 hour.

name: Potion of Gaseous Form
description: Grants the effect of Gaseous Form for 1 hour.

name: Potion of Growth
description: You grow to a larger size for a limited time.

name: Potion of Heroism
description: Gain temporary hit points and the Bless effect for 1 hour.

name: Potion of Invisibility
description: You become invisible for 1 hour.

name: Potion of Mind Reading
description: Grants the effect of Detect Thoughts for 10 minutes.

name: Potion of Speed
description: Grants the effect of Haste for 1 minute without concentration.

name: Potion of Water Breathing
description: You can breathe underwater for 1 hour.

name: Spell Scroll (Cantrip)
description: Single-use scroll holding a cantrip.

name: Spell Scroll (1st Level)
description: Single-use scroll holding a 1st-level spell.

name: Spell Scroll (3rd Level)
description: Single-use scroll holding a 3rd-level spell.

name: Spell Scroll (9th Level)
description: Single-use scroll holding a 9th-level spell.

name: Wand of Magic Missiles
description: This wand has 7 charges. Expend 1 or more to cast Magic Missile.

name: Wand of Binding
description: Expend charges to cast Hold Monster or Hold Person, or to assist against an escape.

name: Wand of Enemy Detection
description: Expend a charge to sense hostile creatures nearby.

name: Wand of Fear
description: Expend charges to command or frighten creatures.

name: Wand of Fireballs
description: Expend charges to cast Fireball.

name: Wand of Lightning Bolts
description: Expend charges to cast Lightning Bolt.

name: Wand of Magic Detection
description: Expend a charge to cast Detect Magic.

name: Wand of Paralysis
description: Expend a charge to paralyze a creature on a failed save.

name: Wand of Polymorph
description: Expend a charge to cast Polymorph.

name: Wand of Secrets
description: Expend a charge to detect hidden doors and traps nearby.

name: Wand of Web
description: Expend charges to cast Web.

name: Wand of Wonder
description: Expend a charge to trigger a random magical effect.

name: Staff of Fire
attunementPrereq: by a druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
description: Expend charges for fire spells; grants resistance to fire.

name: Staff of Frost
attunementPrereq: by a druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
description: Expend charges for cold spells; grants resistance to cold.

name: Staff of Healing
attunementPrereq: by a bard, cleric, or druid
description: Expend charges to cast healing spells.

name: Staff of Power
attunementPrereq: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
description: Expend charges for a range of offensive and defensive spells.

name: Staff of Striking
description: Expend charges to add force damage to a melee hit.

name: Staff of Charming
attunementPrereq: by a bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
description: Expend charges to cast charm and compulsion spells.

name: Staff of Swarming Insects
attunementPrereq: by a bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
description: Expend charges to summon insects or cast Insect Plague.

name: Staff of the Magi
attunementPrereq: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
description: Expend charges for a wide range of spells; can absorb incoming spells.

name: Decanter of Endless Water
description: Pour out water on command; each charge is one of the decanter modes.

name: Pearl of Power
description: Recover an expended spell slot; usable once per day.

name: Wand of the War Mage +1
description: +1 bonus to spell attack rolls while held.

name: Cloak of the Bat
description: Advantage on Stealth checks; grants flight in dim light or darkness.

name: Ring of Shooting Stars
description: Gives light-based powers in dim light or darkness; expend charges for ball lightning or shooting stars.

name: Ring of the Ram
description: Expend charges to make a ram-shaped force attack.

name: Ring of Three Wishes
description: Expend a charge to cast Wish. Crumbles to dust when the last charge is used.

name: Necklace of Fireballs
description: A string of beads; detach one to hurl as a Fireball. Starts with up to nine beads.

name: Bag of Holding
description: The interior holds far more than the exterior suggests; only the bag itself counts toward encumbrance.

name: Handy Haversack
description: A backpack with extradimensional side pouches; its contents do not add to carried weight.

name: Portable Hole
description: A cloth that unfolds into a 6-foot-deep extradimensional hole; its contents do not add to carried weight.

name: Ring of Warmth
description: Grants cold resistance and comfort in extreme cold while attuned.

name: Ring of Protection
description: +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while attuned.

name: Cloak of Protection
description: +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while attuned.

name: Amulet of Health
description: Your Constitution score becomes 19 while attuned.

name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
description: Your Strength score becomes 19 while attuned.

name: Headband of Intellect
description: Your Intelligence score becomes 19 while attuned.

name: Boots of Elvenkind
description: Your steps make no sound; advantage on Stealth checks that rely on moving silently.

name: Vorpal Sword
description: +3 magic sword that can sever heads on a natural 20.

name: Holy Avenger
description: +3 magic weapon with bonus radiant damage against fiends and undead.

name: Robe of the Archmagi
attunementPrereq: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
description: Improves AC, saving throws, and spell attack numbers for spellcasters.

name: Sphere of Annihilation
description: A black sphere that destroys any matter it touches.

name: Well of Many Worlds
description: A cloth that opens a portal to another world when laid out.

name: Dragon Orb
description: Ancient magical orb that can dominate dragons; wielded at great personal risk.
